name: Mingyue Huo
description: Mingyue Huo is a PhD candidate at UIUC working on multimodal AI, post-training, reinforcement learning, and human-aligned foundation-model evaluation.
bio: I am a PhD candidate in Computational Linguistics at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, advised by Prof. Yan Tang. I expect to graduate in December 2026.

My research focuses on speech and multimodal AI. I work on foundation-model evaluation and post-training, drawing on speech representation learning, multi-speaker understanding, and human speech perception.

This fall, I am a research intern at Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories (MERL), working on long-form audio understanding. Previously, I interned at Netflix, Tencent AI Lab, Amazon Prime Video, and ByteDance AI Lab.
availability: I am seeking full-time Research Scientist or Applied Scientist roles and am available in mid-December 2026.
interests: Multimodal foundation models; post-training and alignment: supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and reinforcement learning
End-to-end multi-speaker understanding and speech representation learning
Human-aligned evaluation, LLM-as-Judge, and reward modeling

experience.text: Long-form audio understanding in real-world multi-speaker meetings.
Diagnostic audio LLM judges, human preference supervision, and post-training for cross-lingual speech generation.
General-purpose speech representations and audio-language understanding; contributions to the Auden toolkit.
Text-guided target speech extraction and the TextrolMix dataset.
Mandarin and Japanese text-to-speech, singing synthesis, and perceptual evaluation.

projects.name: SpeechCritic
projects.subtitle: Diagnostic audio LLM judges from limited human preferences
projects.text: Developed during my Netflix internship, SpeechCritic combines human-calibrated supervision with SFT, OPD, and RL to train and evaluate diagnostic speech judges across perceptual dimensions.

figure.alt: SpeechCritic Figure 1: diagnostic judging and the data, supervision, SFT, OPD, RL, and evaluation pipeline
figure.caption: Figure 1 · SpeechCritic: diagnostic judging, training, and evaluation.

projects.name: SpeechJudgeAudit
projects.subtitle: Auditing speech LLM judges
projects.text: Controlled stimuli and evaluation tools for studying how loudness, content, and emotional delivery affect speech judgments.

projects.name: TagSpeech
projects.subtitle: End-to-end meeting transcription: who spoke what, and when
projects.text: TagSpeech unifies multi-speaker ASR, speaker diarization, and timestamp prediction. Dual speech encoders and interleaved time anchors produce structured, speaker-attributed meeting transcripts.

figure.alt: TagSpeech Figure 2: dual semantic and speaker encoders, projectors, time anchors, and an LLM generating transcripts with speaker labels and timestamps
figure.caption: Figure 2 · TagSpeech: dual-stream encoding and time-aware transcription.

projects.name: Auden-Voice
projects.subtitle: General-purpose voice representations
projects.text: A general-purpose voice encoder for speaker identity, paralinguistic understanding, and LLM-QA, with multi-task and contrastive learning experiments and open-source training recipes in Auden.

figure.alt: Auden-Voice Figure 1: a Zipformer voice encoder and evaluation setups for linear probing, speaker verification, diarization, speech-text retrieval, zero-shot classification, and LLM question answering
figure.caption: Figure 1 · Auden-Voice: voice encoder and speech-language evaluation.

projects.name: StyleTSE
projects.subtitle: Text-guided target speech extraction · ICASSP 2025
projects.text: Developed during my Amazon Prime Video internship, StyleTSE extracts target speech from mixtures using natural-language descriptions and optional audio clues. TextrolMix supplies paired speech mixtures and speaking-style descriptions.

figure.alt: StyleTSE Figure 1: a separation network conditioned on text and audio clues, with attention pooling and gated multimodal fusion
figure.caption: Figure 1 · StyleTSE: speech separation with text and audio clues.
